unit_attributes.statement: From the amount appropriated under section 9903(a) of this title for each fiscal year that remains after making the reservations required in section 9903(b) of this title, the Secretary must allot to each State (subject to section 9911 of this title) an amount that bears the same ratio to such remaining amount as the amount received by the State for fiscal year 1981 under section 2808 of this title bore to the total amount received by all States for fiscal year 1981 under such section, except that no State shall receive less than 1/4 of 1 percent of the amount appropriated under section 9903(a) of this title for such fiscal year, and except as provided in subsection (b).

Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3), if the amount appropriated under section 9903(a) of this title for a fiscal year that remains after the Secretary makes the reservations required in section 9903(b) of this title exceeds $345,000,000, the Secretary must allot to each State not less than 1/2 of 1 percent of the amount appropriated under section 9903(a) of this title for such fiscal year.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3), if the amount appropriated under section 9903(a) of this title for a fiscal year that remains after the Secretary makes the reservations required in section 9903(b) of this title exceeds $345,000,000

unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (1) shall not apply with respect to a fiscal year if the amount allotted under subsection (a) to any State for that year is less than the amount allotted under section 9903(a)(1) of this title (as in effect on September 30, 1989) to such State for fiscal year 1990.
unit_attributes.scope_text: if the amount allotted under subsection (a) to any State for that year is less than the amount allotted under section 9903(a)(1) of this title (as in effect on September 30, 1989) to such State for fiscal year 1990

unit_attributes.statement: The amount allotted under paragraph (1) to a State for a fiscal year must be reduced, if necessary, so that the aggregate amount allotted to such State under such paragraph and subsection (a) does not exceed 140 percent of the aggregate amount allotted to such State under the corresponding provisions of this chapter for the preceding fiscal year.
unit_attributes.scope_text: if necessary, so that the aggregate amount allotted to such State under such paragraph and subsection (a) does not exceed 140 percent of the aggregate amount allotted to such State under the corresponding provisions of this chapter for the preceding fiscal year

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary must make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b), and must make payments for the grants in accordance with section 6503(a) of title 31.
In this section, the term "State" does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
